description: Get a course syllabus as plain text, converted from Canvas HTML. Read-only. The text is fenced as untrusted. If the instructor uploaded the syllabus as a file instead, look in list_course_files; syllabus_digest pulls out dates and weights.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_syllabus
title: Get Syllabus
